name: icu Number toLocaleString currency and percent
source: function main(): void { console.log((1234.5).toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }), (1234.5).toLocaleString("de-DE", { style: "currency", currency: "EUR" }), (1234.5).toLocaleString("ja-JP", { style: "currency", currency: "JPY" }), (1234.5).toLocaleString("fr-FR", { style: "currency", currency: "EUR" }), (1234.5).toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "EUR", currencyDisplay: "code" }), (1234.5).toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD", currencyDisplay: "name" }), (0.256).toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "percent" }), (0.256).toLocaleString("de-DE", { style: "percent", minimumFractionDigits: 1 }), (-1234.5).toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" })); }
